hv.reading: NOT 'flat'. Pooled 16.4897 -> 16.223 (mean delta -0.014) hides the game-level picture: one game lost HALF its progress proxy (g50t 0.6667 -> 0.3333, -50.0 percent, a full step of a 3-step measure) and one gained a twelfth (m0r0 0.7333 -> 0.8000, +9.1 percent). 1 better / 1 worse, but a 5x asymmetry in magnitude, and the loss is the collapse game.

per_level_score_conversion.formula: min((baseline/agent)**2, 115); baseline cancels in the arm ratio

live_action_budget_analysis.why: The live eval bounds actions per game (MAX_ACTIONS 400 on the submitted path), so a level first banked at action 1975 of a 2000-action measurement budget is a level the scored run never reaches. This re-reads the SAME cells at the budget that actually decides a submission.

evidence_floor_sensitivity.why: min_observations is the one tuning knob the mechanism has, and the k=1 arm's single capability loss (cd82) is exactly what a false-positive deferral would look like. Raising the evidence floor to 4 tests that hypothesis directly.
evidence_floor_sensitivity.levels_net_at_k4: NET NEUTRAL, not net-negative. cd82 loses a level at k=4 as it does at k=1 (2 -> 1), but m0r0 GAINS one (0 -> 1), so the k=4 total is 14 -- equal to control's 14. The recommendation's phrase 'cd82 loses a level at both evidence floors' is true of cd82 and must not be read as the k=4 arm being behind on levels overall.

inference_substrate_note: The live E3AgentPolicy cascade takes real actions against the offline arcade with CARNOT_ARC_DISABLE_INDUCTION=1 and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty. No GGUF is loaded, no llama-server is started, no GPU is touched, and no scored or online game is played.
solve_provenance_note: Public-game offline measurement of a SEARCH-POLICY change. No level is claimed as banked by this artifact and no registry entry is written. The mechanism itself is live-agent self-discovery -- it learns only from the running agent's own observed transitions, needs no adapter, no game source and no generator, and is therefore as available on a hidden game as on a public one -- but THIS RUN is a dev measurement.
verifier_is_oracle_note: The memory is a frequency tally over the agent's own observed frame deltas. It never consults the win condition; the level counter (the oracle) is only ever READ as the outcome metric, and enters the mechanism solely as the SACRED veto that protects a label which already banked a level.
used_env_source_note: The hand-verifier progress proxy calls the adapter's public callable against the live runtime game object, per arc_actions_to_progress. No game .py source is read.

prior_failures.verdict: complete: inert_click_pruner ... zero new wins any seed, lost ft09 on 2 of 3 seeds, states_expanded +12.0% pooled / +37.9% non-HUD, recommend do not flip and retire
prior_failures.root_cause_diagnosed: It keyed on a STRUCTURAL blob signature (color, pixel_count, is_rect, twin_count), so evidence about one blob suppressed clicks on every look-alike blob; and it DROPPED rows from node['untested'], shortening the node's list, retiring it from the frontier early and buying navigation.
prior_failures.what_is_different_here: (1) KEY: the literal (action_id, x, y) the agent will send, which generalizes across STATES and across nothing else -- measured 98.4% precision / 71.7% recall on 43,533 roster probe actions. (2) CONSEQUENCE: this never drops a row; it changes only WHICH row a node pops next, and abstains entirely once every remaining row is deferrable, so node['untested'] length and therefore _node_has_open_tier and the frontier schedule are untouched. (3) CHANNEL: it learns from _last_unmasked_hash, which _ingest maintains unconditionally, rather than awaiting['previous_frame'], which nine unrelated components gate.

positive_control_the_lever_is_not_inert.why_this_matters: A null claim is not a finding unless the mechanism demonstrably had the opportunity to act (CLAUDE.md FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK).
positive_control_the_lever_is_not_inert.conclusion: The lever fired on 15 of 25 games, cut its own target class by more than half with p=0.0018 on the game-clustered sign test, and changed the action trace on every game it fired on. The progress nulls are therefore measured nulls on an ACTIVE mechanism, not a degenerate no-op.

measurement_defect_found_and_discarded_i.what: The FIRST A/B corpus was thrown away, not repaired. While it was running in the background, this session hot-swapped python/carnot/agentic/arc_competition_agent.py to the HEAD version for ~20 seconds to check whether three unrelated pre-existing test failures were pre-existing. Seven of 225 cells provably ran against the pre-change source, identified by an AttributeError in their own inert_label_defer_diagnostics field.
measurement_defect_found_and_discarded_i.why_discarded_rather_than_re_run_cell_by: The 7 cells are the ones that ANNOUNCED the swap. A cell that ran during the window with the flag off would have been behaviourally identical and silent, so the contaminated set cannot be bounded from the artifacts alone.
measurement_defect_found_and_discarded_i.how_the_reported_corpus_is_protected: The source sha256 of both changed files was recorded before the clean run started and verified byte-identical after it finished; no cell in the reported corpus carries a diagnostics error; nothing was edited while it ran.

design_limits_stated_up_front.seed_axis_is_decorative: 0 of 25 games produced a different action trace across the three seeds in either arm. random.seed/np.random.seed do not reach the explorer's own frontier RNG, so the three seeds are ONE observation repeated, not three replicates. The effective unit of analysis is the GAME (25 units) and the artifact reports it that way.
design_limits_stated_up_front.minimum_reachable_p: The pre-registered test is a two-sided paired sign test clustered at the game, so min p = 2 * 0.5**k with k discordant games: k>=6 for 0.05. On the primary progress axis (levels) only ONE game moved, so the design COULD NOT reach 0.05 there no matter what the effect was. This is stated as a design limit, not discovered afterwards.
design_limits_stated_up_front.budget_2000_is_not_the_live_budget: The measurement budget is 2000 actions because that is where the roster produces progress signal at all (11 of 25 games bank a level). The live per-game budget is 400. Both readings are reported; they disagree, and the 400 reading is the one relevant to a submission.
design_limits_stated_up_front.no_llm_in_the_loop: Induction is disabled, so this measures the SEARCH. The census that motivated the work found the inert-probe share is the same with the generator on and off, but this run does not re-establish that.

honest_verdict.principle: Self-declared terminal state lets the reconciler classify the run without re-running it; a terminal prefix keeps the partial-token matcher from false-positiving on words like 'worse' or 'null'.

random_seeds_used.principle: Determinism is the precondition for reproducibility. Recorded even though the seed axis turned out to be inert -- which is itself a finding the field makes checkable.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: Content hash of the full result payload, so a later reader can tell a re-derived number from a re-read one.

aa_noise_floor.principle: Two identically-configured arms in separate processes. 75/75 identical traces means the agent is deterministic here, which is a STRONGER statement than any p-value: every treatment divergence is causal, not sampled.

live_action_budget_analysis.principle: Prevents the measurement budget from flattering either arm. A level banked at action 1975 of 2000 does not exist at the live budget of 400.

positive_control_the_lever_is_not_inert.principle: A null on an unfired mechanism is a wiring bug reported as a finding. This field is what separates the two.

navigation_actions.reading: SIGNIFICANTLY WORSE. The retired signature pruner's failure mode reappears in a different form: this lever does not shorten node lists, but by finding an effective action sooner it leaves nodes open and builds a deeper graph, and navigating that graph costs 1 + depth per RESET-replay.

acceptance_gate.pre_registered_primary: paired game-clustered sign test on levels_gained at budget 2000; PASS = defer > control with p < 0.05
acceptance_gate.primary_verdict: FAIL (0 games better, 1 worse; k=1 discordant so min reachable p = 1.0)
acceptance_gate.post_hoc_disclosed_as_such_live_400_budg: 3 -> 6 games banking a level; 3 gained, 0 lost; p = 0.25, and min reachable p is ALSO 0.25 with k=3, so this axis could not have been significant either. Promoted because the pre-registered budget-2000 level count answers a question the live eval does not ask, not because it read better.
acceptance_gate.recommendation: DO NOT flip SUBMITTED_INERT_LABEL_DEFER_ENABLED yet. The mechanism is confirmed (54 percent cut in its target class, p=0.0018) and the per-level efficiency effect on the inert-heavy games is large and now natively reproduced at the live 400-action budget (ft09 x59.5, lp85 x9.0, su15 x2.5 on the first level's score, control banking 0 levels on all three). But no progress axis reached significance, navigation is significantly worse (p=0.013), one game (g50t) collapses -- frontier exhausted at 1022 of 2000 actions with 60 percent fewer states and half the hv progress -- and cd82 loses a level at both evidence floors (though k=4 is net-neutral on levels because m0r0 gains one). The next measurement is a LIVE-BUDGET (400-action) A/B with enough games banking to make the primary axis reachable, plus a diagnosis of the g50t frontier collapse, which is the mechanism's real failure mode -- not another 2000-action roster sweep.
acceptance_gate.corrected_after_adversarial_review: Two rows of the original artifact were misleading and are corrected in `action_ledger_correction`: (1) `actions` (games_better 1, games_worse 0) is not an efficiency result -- its sole mover g50t is this arm's worst capability regression, and the budget is binding in 75/75 control cells so no saving was observable at all; (2) `hv` was described as flat, which is the pooled reading and hides a game that lost half its progress proxy. The recommendation below is unchanged and, if anything, better supported.

action_ledger_correction.why: The `paired_game_clustered.actions` row reads `games_better 1, games_worse 0` and 50000 -> 49022. Read alone that is a 978-action saving. It is not one: the single mover is g50t, and g50t is this arm's worst capability regression. This block is the correction, added after an adversarial review of the committed artifact.

the_budget_is_binding_so_a_saving_is_str.the_only_cells_below_budget: g50t, all three seeds, 1022 of 2000 actions, timed_out=false
the_budget_is_binding_so_a_saving_is_str.reading: Every control cell spends the entire 2000-action budget. An arm that reached the same place in fewer actions would simply keep exploring and still report 2000. So NO action saving was measured by this design, and none could have been. What was measured is a COMPOSITION shift inside a fixed budget.

navigation.note: also the largest single nav improvement in the corpus

the_sole_action_mover_is_a_collapse_g50t.terminated: frontier exhausted at action 1022; timed_out=false, so this is not a wall-clock cut
the_sole_action_mover_is_a_collapse_g50t.mechanism: The lever fired 31 times on g50t (deferred_pops=31, rows_deferred=53, abstained=0, labels_tracked=5). It never DROPS a row, so per-node work is unchanged -- but it changes the ORDER in which states are discovered, and on g50t that order closed the reachable frontier out at 56 states instead of 142. Fewer actions here means less exploration, not cheaper exploration.
the_sole_action_mover_is_a_collapse_g50t.consequence_for_the_two_rows_it_dominate: `actions` and `nav` are UNINFORMATIVE as reported. g50t is the only mover of `actions` and the largest mover of `nav`, and in both it moves because the run stopped early having explored 60 percent less. Neither row should be cited as an efficiency result.

where_the_freed_actions_went.unit: actions per single pass over the 25-game roster (cell sums / 3 seeds)
where_the_freed_actions_went.reading: 3991 of the 4969 actions freed from the inert class (80.3 percent) were re-spent inside the same budget -- mostly on board-moving probes (+2234) and on navigation (+1281 walk/replay, +476 resets). This is why a 54 percent cut in the target class moves total actions by 2 percent.

action_ledger_correction.score_conversion_not_supported_by_this_r: The task premise that motivated this work converted a class cut into a score multiplier (zero the inert class -> -19.13 percent actions -> min((baseline/agent)^2,115) = 1.53x). That conversion requires the TRAJECTORY to shorten, and under a binding budget it did not. This artifact never asserted the 1.53x figure and the review's claim that it did is wrong -- but the premise is retracted here explicitly so it is not carried forward. The `per_level_score_conversion` block is a DIFFERENT and still-valid quantity: actions to the FIRST level-up, which is not budget-bound because it is reached before the budget.

arm_is_decided_by_the_env_var_not_the_ar.fact: scripts/arc_inert_label_defer_worker.py sets out['arm']=args.arm AFTER run_cell returns; run_cell never sees it.
arm_is_decided_by_the_env_var_not_the_ar.consequence: Re-running the worker with --arm defer but WITHOUT CARNOT_ARC_INERT_LABEL_DEFER=1 silently produces a CONTROL trace under a defer label.
arm_is_decided_by_the_env_var_not_the_ar.what_proves_each_cell_was_armed: the per-cell `flag_env` field, which records the env var as the worker actually saw it

solve_conditioning_audit.why: Solve-conditioning invalidated an earlier run in this program, so it is answered explicitly here rather than assumed.

no_game_adapter_reaches_the_agent.checked: grep for get_adapter across python/carnot/agentic/arc_competition_agent.py and arc_solver_kit.py
no_game_adapter_reaches_the_agent.result: zero call sites; no per-game hand-built adapter can influence a decision in this chain

no_solved_trajectory_is_fed_in.checked: grep for build_progress_window / solve_adaptered across the three A/B scripts
no_solved_trajectory_is_fed_in.result: build_progress_window appears exactly once, as a docstring line in arc_inert_label_defer_worker.py explaining why it is avoided (it requires the game already solved to L1 and returns a winning trajectory). solve_adaptered is never imported.

every_cell_starts_from_a_cold_reset.result: 250/250 start_level=0 and exactly one bootstrap.reset; no adapter warmup is applied

induction_is_genuinely_off.result: 0; the induce/verify/plan path never engaged, so this measures the SEARCH

the_one_bit_of_identity_keyed_knowledge_.what: arc_strategy_router.detect_mechanic reads the recorded `mechanic_class` for the NAMED game out of ops/arc_solve_registry.yaml. That value is solve-derived, and it sets uses_goal_distance_heuristic, which sets the explore budget.
the_one_bit_of_identity_keyed_knowledge_.scope: 2 of 25 games. sb26 -> color_match_slot_sequence and tn36 -> program_editor; the other 23 resolve to DEFAULT_MECHANIC=graph_explore, which is exactly what a game absent from the registry (i.e. a hidden game) would get. Recomputed fresh: routed explore_budget matches the recorded per-cell explore_budget in 25/25 games (24 for sb26 and tn36, 80 for the rest).

is_it_load_bearing.test: force the hidden-game budget (80) on the two routed games, and the routed budget (24) on a control game; compare trace_sha256 against the banked cell
is_it_load_bearing.reading: exactly one game of 25 has a trace that depends on registry-derived knowledge. Note this is only PARTIALLY inert even with induction off: no plan.execute_step ever fired, yet the stall test still flips phase on the explore budget.

the_one_bit_of_identity_keyed_knowledge_.can_it_bias_the_A_B: No. Both arms receive the identical routed value on every game, and the A/A floor is 75/75 identical traces. It is a scope caveat on HIDDEN-GAME transfer, not a defect in the comparison.
the_one_bit_of_identity_keyed_knowledge_.why_the_provenance_label_is_already_corr: solve_provenance is development_proxy, not live_agent_self_discovery, precisely because of this. It faithfully mirrors what the SHIPPED E3AgentPolicy does on a public game.

live_400_budget_natively_reproduced.why: The 3 -> 6 headline was computed by re-reading 2000-budget traces at a 400-action cutoff. If the agent's behaviour depended on the budget it was given, that truncation would be invalid. Tested by running the three gained games NATIVELY at --budget 400.
live_400_budget_natively_reproduced.result: 3/3 exact match, and control banks 0 levels on all three at a native 400 budget. The 3 -> 6 reading is not a truncation artifact: the first-level path is budget-independent over this range.
live_400_budget_natively_reproduced.still_not_significant: This does not rescue the axis. k=3 discordant games gives min reachable p = 0.25, so the live-budget reading could not have reached 0.05 either. It is a real effect on three games, not a corpus result.

benchmark_score_conversion.formula_correction: The task premise used min((baseline/agent)^2, 115). The INSTALLED competition scorer (arc_agi.scorecard, the package the gateway runs) is min((baseline/agent)^2 * 100, 115.0) per LEVEL, an unsolved level scores 0.0, and the GAME score is an index-weighted mean over the full level list CLAMPED to max_weights/total_weights*100. Two consequences the premise omits: (1) a game can never score above what human-speed play on the levels it solved would have scored, so superhuman efficiency is worth exactly zero as a bonus and efficiency only pays as COMPENSATION for being slower than human; (2) DEPTH is the dominant lever, not speed. See docs/research-notes/arc-agi3-kaggle-submission-requirements-2026-06-17.md (2026-07-26 correction).
benchmark_score_conversion.method: EnvironmentScoreCalculator driven exactly as scripts/arc_leaderboard_eval.py:718-762 drives it. Human baselines are the ones the ENV ITSELF exposes, not an assumed number.

roster_total_25_games.note: the other 19 games bank no level at 400 in either arm and score 0

benchmark_score_conversion.the_honest_reading: The gain is a DEPTH gain, which is the right lever: three games go from 0 levels to 1 inside the live budget, and an unbanked level scores exactly 0 however few actions were spent on it. It is NOT a speed gain in the scoring sense -- the agent is still 6.0x to 13.6x SLOWER than the human baseline on the levels it does bank, so it captures only 0.5 to 2.8 percent of what solving that SAME single level at human speed would have scored. The 59.5x / 9.0x / 2.5x per-level ratios are real but they are ratios between two arms of a very slow agent, not distance to the frontier.
caveats: Offline development-proxy numbers on PUBLIC games, not hidden-game scores.
RESET is charged as an action by the gateway and as zero by the offline harness, so offline efficiency is optimistic by the number of in-level resets.
Three games at k=3 discordant: min reachable sign-test p = 0.25, so this is not a significant corpus result.
